subject: planner: update AnalyzeTableStmt to use NonPartitionTableID for non-partitioned tables (#59937)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff for planner/statistics only. Change replaces magic `-1` partition sentinel with `statistics.NonPartitionTableID` (confirmed `const NonPartitionTableID = -1` in `pkg/statistics/analyze.go`) when building analyze tasks for non-partitioned tables, plus removes an unused `StatsReadWriter.UpdateStatsVersion` wrapper from `pkg/statistics/handle/storage` and the interface. No Blocker/High correctness/semantics/consistency/compatibility issues found; later history shows no follow-up fix indicating a bug in this change.
